eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Porter, IN; at 8:58 AM on AUG 3, 2016 Effective until 4:58 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a test of the Porter County Emergency Alert System. In the event of an emergency, this system would bring you important information. This test was conducted from the Porter County Emergency Management Agency in Valparaiso, Indiana and is now concluded.
